title: Canonical affine cohomology section comparisons without flatness
statement:
Let f : X → S be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism, g : S′ → S any morphism, F a quasi-coherent O_X-module, I an injective resolution of F and J an injective resolution of g′*F, where g′ = pullback.snd g f. Fix p ≥ 0, affine opens V of S and W of S′ with W ⊆ g⁻¹V and restricted resolution choices D [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Put A = Γ(S,V), B = Γ(S′,W), h : U = f⁻¹V → Spec A the affine-chart restriction, N = F restricted to U [def-pc-module-pullback], P = R^p f_* F and Q = R^p f′_* g′*F [pqf-def-cohomology]. There exist an additive equivalence e0 from module cohomology of the restriction to HOver(h,N,p), a B-linear equivalence a0 : B tensor_A HOver(h,N,p) ≃ Γ(W,g*P), and a B-linear equivalence b0 : HOver(h_B,N_B,p) ≃ Γ(W,Q) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. They satisfy a0(s tensor xi) = s times the restriction to W of the tensor-pullback unit applied to D.sourceClass(e0 inverse xi), and b0(baseChangeLinear xi) = restriction to W of D.targetClass(moduleCohomologyFMap(g′ restricted,D.psi,p)(e0 inverse xi)) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No flatness is assumed, no arbitrary additive comparison is supplied, and no bijectivity of the cohomological base-change map is asserted.

Exact Lean statement:
theorem Scheme.Modules.exists_flatBaseChange_affine_canonical_comparisons
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (eVW : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) := (g.appLE V W eVW).hom.toAlgebra
    let h := f.resLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl ≫ V.toSpecΓ
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F
    let P := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerived p).obj F
    let Q := ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).rightDerived p).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F)
    ∃ (e0 : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)) ≃+
          Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p)
      (a0 : TensorProduct Γ(S, V) Γ(S', W) (Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p) ≃ₗ[Γ(S', W)]
        Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj P, W))
      (b0 : Scheme.Modules.HOver (Scheme.Modules.baseChangeSnd (S := Γ(S', W)) h)
          (Scheme.Modules.baseChangedModule (S := Γ(S', W)) h N) p ≃ₗ[Γ(S', W)]
          Γ(Q, W)),
      (∀ (s : Γ(S', W)) (xi : Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p),
        a0 (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V)] xi) = s •
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj P).presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
            (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
              ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app P)
              V (D.sourceClass p (e0.symm xi)))) ∧
      (∀ xi : Scheme.Modules.HOver h N p,
        b0 (Scheme.Modules.H.baseChangeLinear (S := Γ(S', W)) h N p xi) =
          Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE eVW).op
            (D.targetClass p
              (Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p (e0.symm xi))))

proof.text: Apply the target Leray comparison to obtain a natural source family E, additive e0 with its explicit equality to E transported by restrictFunctorIsoPullback, and target linear equivalence b0 with compatibility on e0.

Apply exists_affine_cohomology_section_equiv to D.source and E, using its naturality. This gives the A-linear equivalence e from HOver(h,N,p) to Gamma(P,V). Rewrite by the explicit equality defining e0 to obtain its normalization as D.sourceClass composed with e0 inverse.

P is quasi-coherent. Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to g,V,W and P. Swap the tensor factors and use its scalar equation to build the B-linear map k. Its bijectivity follows from the affine section theorem and the tensor commutation equivalence. Extend e by B using TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.congr and compose with k. LinearEquiv.ofBijective makes this the required a0. Its pure-tensor formula follows by substitution of the normalization of e into the affine pullback unit formula.
The target compatibility from the first step uses precisely the selected e0. Supply it as the second conjunct and assemble e0,a0,b0 and the two normalization formulas.
